sentences.text: No, for this customer’s floating-rate term loan to an individual for a non-business purpose, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges for loans sanctioned on or after 2026-01-01, and this case was sanctioned on 2026-03-01.
The home loan agreement text says a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding, while the copy says 3% of the principal outstanding, so the in-force documents disagree on the charge rate.
Because the applicable UCB direction prohibits pre-payment charges for this case, the agreement clauses do not provide a basis to charge a foreclosure charge here.
